Punctual morning a simple notice for regular visitors
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with pets should review the current booking rules before arrival so the journey can begin smoothly and without delay.

Our team arranges travel support from booking through pickup, and we ask every traveler to check crate fit, comfort items, and entry paperwork before the day of travel. <<FACT F064>> Please ensure that the pet is calm, secure, and ready for screening when you arrive. Clear labels on the carrier help our staff guide each animal with care.

Some animals need added steps before departure, and small dog arrangements may include a required fee. <<FACT F056>> Please confirm any service details in advance, bring the needed documents, and follow the handling guidance given by the desk. Good preparation helps protect the pet, the traveler, and other passengers.

If you need help with an upcoming journey, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate.
